lastCompletedStory.title: Idempotent atomic migration: array to dir, delete issues.local.json

nextStoryContext: US-006 complete. commitTreeToMain now accepts optional removals?: string[] (git update-index --remove, applied after read-tree, before file writes). migrateIssuesToDir exported from scripts/cam/migrate-issues-schema.ts: reads issues.local.json from main via git show, builds FileWrite[] (one per issue, 4-digit padded filename, unpadded id field), commits atomically with deletions via commitTreeToMain. Idempotency: if git show returns non-zero (file absent), returns noOp:true with no commit. 13 new unit tests, all 2050 tests pass. Next story is US-007: live migration script (real-git integration test, actual 129-issue commit).

officialDocsValidated.summary: US-006 extended src/git/on-main.ts and scripts/cam/migrate-issues-schema.ts. Only internal modules and node:child_process (no new external npm library) were used.
